sources.title: [2505.09388] Qwen3 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: In this work, we present Qwen3, the latest version of the Qwen model family. Qwen3 comprises a series of large language models (LLMs) designed to advance performance, efficiency, and multilingual capabilities.
